component.name: FyAgent
component.summary: Personal desktop control center for AI Workers and Agents

description.p: FyAgent is a personal desktop control center for the AI Workers and Agents you use. It brings models, tool connections, Skills, working instructions, configuration, and usage records into one place.
FyAgent is source-available; see the repository LICENSE for its mixed licensing terms.

ul.li: Manage model providers, model choices, and compatible endpoints
Keep tool connections, Skills, and working instructions together
Switch, route, back up, and review usage across supported AI tools
